title: Wardogs rotation (bot import/export format)
description: Structure of a rotation file exported from / imported into the Wardogs server bot. Key order in generated files follows the order listed here.

mode.description: Rotation playback mode. Only 'Ordered' has been seen so far.

map.description: Internal map name, e.g. NorthAmerica (Zestafona), Europe (Ozeti), Kavkazi (Bakurani).

modifiers.description: Mode modifiers, e.g. KOTH_InfantryOnly. May be empty.

zoneAlternator.description: Zone alternator id, e.g. ZoneAlternator.Bakurani.Farmland.Circle. Empty string = default zone.
